name: Are room additions in Los Angeles worth it compared with moving?

mainEntity.name: Are room additions in Los Angeles worth it compared with buying a larger home?
mainEntity.text: Are room additions in Los Angeles worth it compared with buying a larger home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition can be worth it when the current home is in a strong location and the family needs more space than the market can easily provide. It can also be attractive if moving would mean higher mortgage payments, transaction costs, and losing a desirable neighborhood. On the other hand, moving may be the better choice if the existing lot has severe limitations, the addition would require major structural upgrades, or the project cost approaches the price difference of a larger home. Homeowners should compare the all-in cost of the addition against the cost of selling, buying, and relocating. They should also factor in disruption, timeline, and resale expectations. If the addition solves a long-term space problem and fits the home well, it can be a strong investment. If not, moving may be simpler and more financially efficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: A room addition is often worth it when the homeowner likes the location, wants to avoid moving costs, and can add needed space within zoning and budget limits. Moving may make more sense if the addition would be too expensive, too disruptive, or limited by the lot.
